title: RBI Consolidated Supervisory Directions - 64 Master Directions replacing 628 circulars
description: <cite index="42-2">RBI's Department of Supervision replaced 628 circulars and Master Circulars with 64 consolidated Master Directions across 11 entity types, effective July 31, 2026</cite>. This consolidation streamlines regulatory framework for banks, NBFCs and other financial entities.
